title: Lulu and the Little Giraffe | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
Whoosh! The wind blows Lulu's red balloon up into a tree, and Lulu is too small to reach it.
Little Giraffe walks in, stretches her long neck and gives the balloon back. Thank you, Little Giraffe!
The two new friends play all day, then fall asleep under the moon.
A calm bedtime story for children aged 3 to 6.
